description: Drive in style and confidence with this Silver 2022 Toyota RAV4 AWD Limited. This top-of-the-line SUV features an advanced All-Wheel Drive system paired with a smooth 8-speed automatic transmission and a fuel-efficient 2.5L I4 engine. Enjoy luxury and technology with leatherette upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats, JBL premium audio, and a panoramic moonroof. Stay connected with a 9-inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Amazon Alexa, Wi-Fi hotspot, and Toyota Connected Services. Safety is front and center with adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, blind spot monitoring, rear cross traffic alert, front and rear parking sensors, and pre-collision pedestrian detection. Convenience features include a power liftgate, driver memory settings, dual-zone climate control, and a hands-free smart key system. The RAV4 Limited blends comfort, performance, and the latest technology for a premium driving experience. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. description: If you're searching for a 2021 Chevrolet Traverse LT Sport Utility for sale in South Gate, CA, this well-equipped family SUV at CARTIME deserves a serious look. With over 102,000 miles of real-world use behind it, this Traverse has proven it can go the distance — and at CARTIME's competitive pricing, it represents genuine value in the Los Angeles area used SUV market. Whether you're hauling kids to school in Downey, navigating the 710 freeway to Long Beach, or loading up for a weekend trip to Big Bear, this three-row crossover was built for exactly that kind of life. About This 2021 Chevrolet Traverse LT The 2021 model year landed in a strong spot for the Traverse — Chevrolet had ironed out most of the early-generation quirks introduced when this body style debuted in 2018, and the result is a refined, spacious, and genuinely livable family hauler. At 102,351 miles, this Traverse sits in a range that tells you it has been a working family vehicle — not a garage queen, but not abused either. For buyers who want maximum depreciation already absorbed and a capable SUV that still has plenty of life left, this is a realistic sweet spot. The LT trim hits the middle of the Traverse lineup, meaning you get meaningful upgrades over the base LS without paying for the top-tier High Country features you may never use. 2021 Chevrolet Traverse Performance and Engine Under the hood sits Chevrolet's proven 3.6-liter V6 engine, paired with a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission sending power to the front wheels. The 3.6L V6 produces 310 horsepower and 266 lb-ft of torque — figures that put it firmly ahead of most turbocharged four-cylinder competitors in this segment. In real-world driving, that means confident merging on the I-5, responsive passing power on the 405, and enough muscle to handle a loaded vehicle without feeling strained. The 9-speed automatic is calibrated for efficiency, helping the Traverse achieve respectable fuel economy for an SUV of this size — typically in the range of 18 city and 27 highway mpg. Front-wheel drive keeps the mechanicals simpler and lowers long-term ownership costs, making this an ideal fit for Southern California drivers who rarely, if ever, need all-wheel drive traction. Chevrolet Traverse LT Features and InteriorComfort and Space The Traverse LT delivers a genuinely premium cabin experience for the money. Standard seating accommodates up to seven or eight passengers depending on second-row configuration, making it one of the roomier three-row options in its class. Rear passengers — even in the third row — get noticeably more legroom than you'd find in a Ford Explorer or Honda Pilot of the same era. Technology and Convenience The LT trim includes Chevrolet's Infotainment 3 system with an 8-inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, and available Wi-Fi hotspot capability. Safety technology includes forward collision alert, automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist, and rear park assist — features that were increasingly standard on the LT by the 2021 model year. A rearview camera, keyless entry, and remote start round out the daily convenience package that makes living with this SUV genuinely easy. Chevrolet Traverse Reliability and Ownership The 2018-and-later Traverse generation has built a solid reputation among family SUV buyers. The 3.6L V6 is a known quantity — Chevrolet has used variants of this engine across many platforms for years, and it responds well to regular oil changes and basic maintenance. Common ownership feedback highlights the smooth ride, quiet cabin, and intuitive infotainment as standout positives. At higher mileage, buyers should confirm that routine maintenance — particularly transmission fluid, spark plugs, and coolant — has been kept up to date. The 9-speed transmission, while excellent when healthy, benefits from periodic fluid changes. Overall, the Traverse LT represents one of the more ownership-friendly three-row SUVs you can buy used in this price range, especially in a climate like Southern California where road salt and harsh winters simply aren't a factor. Why Buy From CARTIME in South Gate, CA CARTIME has been serving the greater Los Angeles area with quality pre-owned vehicles at straightforward prices. Located in South Gate, the dealership sits in a convenient spot for buyers coming from Lynwood, Huntington Park, Cudahy, Bell Gardens, Maywood, Compton, and throughout Southeast LA. The team at CARTIME understands what local buyers need — transparent pricing, a no-pressure environment, and vehicles that are ready to drive. When you visit the lot, you're dealing with people who know this community and want to earn your repeat business, not just make a one-time sale. Financing a Used Chevrolet Traverse Near South Gate Financing a used SUV doesn't need to be complicated, and the team at CARTIME works with a wide range of lenders to find terms that fit your situation. Whether you're coming in with excellent credit, rebuilding your credit history, or somewhere in between, there are options worth exploring. Buyers throughout the Los Angeles area — from Norwalk to Inglewood, from Torrance to East LA — have found workable financing solutions at CARTIME. Bring your driver's license, proof of income, and proof of insurance, and the finance team can walk you through the numbers the same day. Call 3235082931 to ask about current rates or get pre-qualified before you even step onto the lot. Frequently Asked QuestionsIs the 2021 Chevrolet Traverse a good buy? Yes — the 2021 Traverse is widely regarded as one of the better three-row family SUVs in its class. It offers a spacious cabin, a powerful and reliable V6 engine, and a strong suite of standard safety features. The 2021 model year benefits from several years of production refinement, making it a more polished ownership experience than early examples of this generation. How many miles is too many on a used Chevrolet Traverse? A well-maintained Traverse with 100,000+ miles is not necessarily a red flag. The 3.6L V6 is a durable engine that can routinely reach 200,000 miles with proper care. The key is service history — documented oil changes and transmission maintenance matter more than mileage alone. At 102,351 miles, this Traverse is well into its working life but far from the end of it. What does the Traverse LT trim include? The LT trim adds meaningful features over the base LS, including the 8-inch Infotainment 3 touchscreen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a suite of active safety features, keyless entry, remote start, and upgraded interior materials. It represents the value sweet spot in the Traverse lineup for buyers who want a well-equipped SUV without stepping up to Premier or High Country pricing. Is front-wheel drive okay on a Chevrolet Traverse? For the vast majority of Southern California drivers, front-wheel drive is perfectly sufficient. FWD delivers all the everyday traction you need in dry and light-rain conditions, simplifies the drivetrain for lower long-term maintenance costs, and typically improves fuel economy versus AWD versions. Unless you're regularly driving to mountain destinations in winter snow conditions, FWD is the practical choice in the LA area. What should I check before buying a used Traverse with high mileage? Ask for a vehicle history report, confirm the transmission fluid has been serviced, inspect for any coolant leaks around the thermostat housing (a known but manageable issue on the 3.6L), and listen for any timing chain noise at startup. A pre-purchase inspection from an independent mechanic is always money well spent on any high-mileage vehicle. Serving South Gate and Surrounding Areas CARTIME proudly serves drivers throughout the greater Los Angeles basin. If you're coming from Downey, Paramount, Bellflower, Compton, Hawthorne, or the South Bay, the South Gate location is an easy drive down the I-710 or I-105 corridors. Buyers from East Los Angeles, Montebello, Pico Rivera, and Whittier are also just minutes away. Even if you're coming from further out — Anaheim, Long Beach, Torrance, or the San Gabriel Valley — the drive is worth it for a well-priced, three-row family SUV that's ready to go today. Contact CARTIME Today Ready to get behind the wheel of this 2021 Chevrolet Traverse LT? Don't let it sit on the lot — three-row SUVs at this price point move quickly in the LA market. Call CARTIME at 3235082931 to schedule a test drive, ask about pricing and financing, or simply confirm availability before you make the trip. The team is ready to answer your questions and help you drive home in a vehicle that fits your family and your budget. Come visit us in South Gate and see why buyers from across Southeast Los Angeles trust CARTIME for their next used vehicle purchase.
